messages:
sam_sales: Quick ask — Aurora Labs (seed, healthcare analytics) wants a 12-week pilot to validate embeddings + summarization on de-identified clinical notes. They asked for promotional credits to cover hosted usage and eval tooling. Customer estimate: ~300k tokens/week at peak. Asking for $12k credits to avoid throttling during spike.

taylor_se: Tech check — their planned workload is heavy on short embedding calls so costs skew. Recommend batching embeddings and using the small-embedding model for initial runs. SE ballpark: $5k–$9k for 12 weeks if we cap peak runs. I can ship a reduced harness to constrain spend.

marie_dealdesk: @sam_sales + @dina_finance please fill: exact credit amount, pilot start/end, whether Dedicated or hosted, data sensitivity and signed docs. Note: our discretionary promo pool covers up to $6k without exec signoff. Anything above needs VP OK.

sam_sales: Filling in now: requested = $12,000 credits; pilot window 2026-05-04 to 2026-07-27 (12 weeks); hosted only, no Dedicated/KMS; they will use only de-identified data per legal but want logs/metrics for 90 days. NDA signed, DPA pending.

chris_security: DPA required before any prod/real clinical data. For de-identified data we can accept test runs earlier if they provide attestation and dataset sample. Logs retention extension to 90 days is fine but we need retention policy added to the MOU. Link to checklist: https://redwood.internal/security/pilot-checklist

dina_finance: Finance note — promos >$5k impact revenue recognition; need RevOps signoff and GL coding. Also we require a promo code object created in billing with expiration tied to pilot. Who will own that flow?

marie_dealdesk: Proposal from Deal Desk: offer $6,000 discretionary hosted credits + a promo conversion incentive (25% off first 2 months) if they sign a 12-mo Dedicated commit within 60 days of pilot completion. Extend logs retention 60 days (not 90) — legal OK with that if DPA signed. If customer insists on $12k, escalate to @arthur_vp for one-time exception.

sam_sales: I prefer to present the $6k + 25% conversion discount — sounds fair. Will check if they can scope down initial runs to stay under $6k and use a staged ramp.

arthur_vp: If Aurora shows strong product-market fit in the pilot, we can consider $10k one-time credits, but need a short business case (CAC payback, expected ARR) and AE sign-off. Send me a 1-pager. Otherwise approve $6k as standard.

chris_security: Reminder: no PHI before DPA. We can allow anonymized samples and synthetic data for early runs. Also request that telemetry exclude raw note dumps.

dina_finance: Approved to create a $6k promo code pending RevOps entry. GL: PROMO/2026/Q2. Please email billing@redwood and cc me with deal id AUR-201.

marie_dealdesk: Status: conditional promo-approved for $6,000 hosted credits, 60-day logs, pilot dates listed. DPA required before any sensitive data. For escalation to $10–12k, @sam_sales prepare VP brief and ROI slide.

sam_sales: Thanks team — I'll push the $6k + conversion incentive to the customer now and ask for their agreement on ramping to fit the credits. Will post updates and attach DPA when signed. :thumbsup:
